paragraphs: R. Yehudah ben Pedaya; see Bar Pada. Son of Bar Kappara's sister. Bereshit Rabbah, section 21; Kedoshim, section 25. He objected before R. Yonah: Sheviit, chapter 5. R. Yudan Gidya said, “This Choni the Circle-Drawer”—Jerusalem Taanit, chapter 3, halakhah 10. [The checked Taanit at 3:9:4 reads Yudan Giraya and identifies this Choni as a grandson of Choni the Circle-Drawer.]
